title: Special permit to shift floor area for 801 Eleventh Avenue project
summary: This application would let the developer of 801 Eleventh Avenue in Manhattan transfer 64,392 square feet of floor area from several nearby sites, including portions of Hudson River Park piers, to its site and modify street wall rules. It supports a mixed-use residential and commercial development totaling 386,350 square feet and would help fund improvements and maintenance in Hudson River Park. The Council held a public hearing on May 27, 2026 and its Subcommittee recommended approval with modifications on June 25, 2026.
